name: Plague-Bag
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The plague-bag makes two Clasp attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Clinging Grasp.

Actions.name: Clasp
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Clinging Grasp
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).
Actions.expresses: lurking strike from rafters and shadows
Actions.expressedQuote: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the plague-bag takes the Hide action.

lore: Left too long among the dead, a plague-doctor's satchel sprouted finger-boned legs and now stalks the sickhouse rafters, stuffing the dying into its own dark throat because a bag without a master still wants to be filled.

generation.userConcept: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) — the rider-heavy bite and the phase-cycle bonus action, scaled into the band

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
lint_findings: type-damage-affinity: Actions/Clasp: Necrotic damage on Construct — no official Construct deals Necrotic; re-theme the damage to the creature's substance (or the type itself is wrong)
monsterDescription: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
